title: Yo-yo with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="bodyGrad" cx="50%" cy="45%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff6b9d"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e63973"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="rimGrad" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffd93d"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f0a500"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- string -->
  <path d="M50 8 Q48 18 50 30" stroke="#c9d1d9" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- top disc -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="32" ry="12" fill="url(#rimGrad)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="38" rx="32" ry="12" fill="none" stroke="#ffed8a" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- outer rim body -->
  <rect x="18" y="38" width="64" height="24" rx="12" fill="url(#bodyGrad)"/>
  <rect x="18" y="38" width="64" height="24" rx="12" fill="none" stroke="#ffb0cc" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- bottom disc -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="32" ry="12" fill="url(#rimGrad)"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="62" rx="32" ry="12" fill="none" stroke="#ffed8a" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- center band highlight -->
  <rect x="20" y="47" width="60" height="6" rx="3" fill="#ff85ad" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- face area -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="50" rx="20" ry="10" fill="#fff0f5" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="48" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#2d1b33"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="48" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#2d1b33"/>

  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="43.5" cy="46.5" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="59.5" cy="46.5" r="1.5" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M43 53 Q50 59 57 53" stroke="#2d1b33" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx="35" cy="53" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ffb3c6" opacity="0.8"/>
  <ellipse cx="65" cy="53" rx="4" ry="2.5" fill="#ffb3c6" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- string attachment loop -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="36" r="3" fill="#ffd93d" stroke="#f0a500" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- sparkle accents -->
  <path d="M25 42 l1.5 -3 l1.5 3 l-3 -1.5 l3 -1.5 z" fill="#ffe066" opacity="0.8"/>
  <path d="M72 58 l1.5 -3 l1.5 3 l-3 -1.5 l3 -1.5 z" fill="#ffe066" opacity="0.8"/>
</svg>
